blockingFindings.description: Direct inspection of all eleven renders after extending the lower inner-rise vertices to the centerline and resizing the four-edge diamond gusset. Crouch still shows a triangular avatar-surface opening at the inner crotch; seated pose still exposes gray upper-thigh surface around the shorts. The revised gusset does not provide continuous coverage. No measured fit, opacity, motion or Shape Key acceptance.

Direct inspection of five views and six poses: the standing overskirt remains a broad, lightly defined A-line with irregular faceted folds rather than ordered pleats. Crouch/sit/prone show large angular rear and between-leg sheets and curling/folding hem. No appearance acceptance.

Direct inspection of arms-up and arm-cross: sleeve caps and underarm transitions remain visibly faceted and wrinkled; the high collar ends as an open cylindrical rim. Surface and neckline remain unresolved. No fit, strain, clearance or runtime acceptance.

outOfScope: VRChat Build & Test and runtime inspection
